name: Workspace
notes: Arrange displays and configure their modes, scaling, rotation, wallpaper, menu bar and dock.
Sovel Files adds tabs, split view, Recent, Starred, previews, Downloads and persistent background transfers.
Browse removable drives, mount and safely eject them, and work with ZIP, 7Z, TAR and GZ archives.
JARED adds local Notes, Projects and Research, scoped file search, task review and previews on a chosen display.
JARED supports CPU speech with Whisper and Piper and can use local Qwen3.5 4B when the GPU and Ollama are ready.
